scroll_of_cure_wounds.name: scroll of cure wounds
scroll_of_cure_wounds.lore: A common apprentice-healer's scroll. Two dice of restoration in a single spoken word.

scroll_of_healing.name: scroll of healing
scroll_of_healing.lore: Temple-scribe copy of the standard healing prayer. Twice the flesh-mending of the apprentice cantrip.

scroll_of_vigor.name: scroll of vigor
scroll_of_vigor.lore: Druidic vigor-rite. Bark and sap wash through the reader, closing wounds faster than they were made.

scroll_of_rejuvenation.name: scroll of rejuvenation
scroll_of_rejuvenation.lore: Physician-mages of the late Empire could patch a mortally wounded knight and return him to the line in one breath. This is that breath, on parchment.

scroll_of_full_restoration.name: scroll of full restoration
scroll_of_full_restoration.lore: The lost restorative liturgy of the Cathedral of St. John of God. Read it well and death itself hesitates.

scroll_of_local_mapping.name: scroll of local mapping
scroll_of_local_mapping.lore: A surveyor's rough shorthand. Reveals the ground within a few dozen paces.

scroll_of_area_mapping.name: scroll of area mapping
scroll_of_area_mapping.lore: A journeyman surveyor's kit-scroll. Chalk lines expand across your inner sight in every direction.

scroll_of_cartography.name: scroll of cartography
scroll_of_cartography.lore: The Cartographers' Guild seal on the wax. The scroll knows what the walls of the corridor look like even before you round the bend.

scroll_of_deep_mapping.name: scroll of deep mapping
scroll_of_deep_mapping.lore: A dwarven deep-survey working. The lines it draws in the mind are the corridors, room by room, out to the boundary of the level.

scroll_of_dungeon_mapping.name: scroll of dungeon mapping
scroll_of_dungeon_mapping.lore: The entire floor unfolds in your mind at once, every corridor, every chamber, every stairwell.

scroll_of_identify.name: scroll of identify
scroll_of_identify.lore: Truth-ink from ground moonstone. Reveals the true name and nature of one item you choose.

scroll_of_identify_two.name: scroll of identify two
scroll_of_identify_two.lore: Two truth-sigils bound in a single wax seal. Reveals a pair of items in one breath.

scroll_of_identify_three.name: scroll of identify three
scroll_of_identify_three.lore: A merchant-appraiser's stock scroll. Names three items and their honest natures at once.

scroll_of_mass_identify.name: scroll of mass identify
scroll_of_mass_identify.lore: The true-name working, spoken in the tongue of knowledge itself. Every unnamed item you bear is laid bare.

scroll_of_omnisight.name: scroll of omnisight
scroll_of_omnisight.lore: The Argus-sight rite. Every hidden name in your pack is revealed, and one corpse you carry gives up its lore as well.

scroll_of_sharpen.name: scroll of sharpen
scroll_of_sharpen.lore: A smith's first working. Sharpens the melee blade in your hand by one honing.

scroll_of_weapon_blessing.name: scroll of weapon blessing
scroll_of_weapon_blessing.lore: A temple-armorer's blessing. Sanctifies both the blade and the bow you carry.

scroll_of_enchant_weapon.name: scroll of enchant weapon
scroll_of_enchant_weapon.lore: The standard weaponsmith's enchantment scroll. Two runes burn themselves into every weapon you wield.

scroll_of_weaponsmith.name: scroll of the weaponsmith
scroll_of_weaponsmith.lore: The master-armorers of the dwarven academies signed and sealed this working. Three layers of enchantment onto every weapon you carry.

scroll_of_legendary_edge.name: scroll of the legendary edge
scroll_of_legendary_edge.lore: The legendary-edge working. Not only does it enchant three times, it pushes one weapon a full step past its natural ceiling.

scroll_of_bracing.name: scroll of bracing
scroll_of_bracing.lore: A journeyman armorer's bracing-rite. One piece of your kit is tightened, reinforced, and made just a little truer.

scroll_of_armor_blessing.name: scroll of armor blessing
scroll_of_armor_blessing.lore: A temple-armorer's benediction over two pieces of worn kit.

scroll_of_enchant_armor.name: scroll of enchant armor
scroll_of_enchant_armor.lore: Standard armorer's-guild enchantment scroll. Three pieces of your kit are tightened, aligned, and hardened by two.

scroll_of_armorer.name: scroll of the armorer
scroll_of_armorer.lore: The master-armorer's working, signed in three languages. Four pieces of your armor are reinforced by two.

scroll_of_legendary_ward.name: scroll of the legendary ward
scroll_of_legendary_ward.lore: The legendary-ward working. Every plate, every buckle, every strap of your kit is elevated by three.

scroll_of_uncurse.name: scroll of uncurse
scroll_of_uncurse.lore: An acolyte's uncurse-rite. Loosens the first cursed piece of gear you're wearing.

scroll_of_purity.name: scroll of purity
scroll_of_purity.lore: A monastic purification rite. Every cursed piece of gear you wear is unbound.

scroll_of_cleansing.name: scroll of cleansing
scroll_of_cleansing.lore: A priest-exorcist's cleansing. Curses fall from your gear and afflictions fall from your body.

scroll_of_purification.name: scroll of purification
scroll_of_purification.lore: The purification liturgy from the Egyptian Book of Coming Forth by Day. Every cursed thing you carry, worn or stowed, is unbound.

scroll_of_sanctification.name: scroll of sanctification
scroll_of_sanctification.lore: The sanctification working. Uncurses everything and, beyond that, blesses one piece of worn gear for free.

scroll_of_ward.name: scroll of ward
scroll_of_ward.lore: A watchman's ward-charm. A thin shell of protective force wraps you for ten heartbeats.

scroll_of_protection.name: scroll of protection
scroll_of_protection.lore: A prayer of warding inscribed by temple acolytes. The words form a protective shell around the reader.

scroll_of_greater_protection.name: scroll of greater protection
scroll_of_greater_protection.lore: A greater-warding rite from the Order of the Shield. Three layers of protection for thirty heartbeats.

scroll_of_aegis.name: scroll of aegis
scroll_of_aegis.lore: The aegis-rite of Athena's temple. A shield that no ordinary blade can find purchase against.

scroll_of_absolute_ward.name: scroll of absolute ward
scroll_of_absolute_ward.lore: The absolute-ward working. Eight layers of unbreachable armor for the space of eighty heartbeats.

scroll_of_bewilderment.name: scroll of bewilderment
scroll_of_bewilderment.lore: A tavern-conjurer's parlor trick. Every hostile creature in sight reels for four heartbeats.

scroll_of_confusion.name: scroll of confusion
scroll_of_confusion.lore: An arena tamer's disorientation-rite. Every hostile creature in sight reels for a dozen heartbeats.

scroll_of_madness.name: scroll of madness
scroll_of_madness.lore: The great madness-working. Every creature in sight is unmoored from sense for twenty-five heartbeats.

scroll_of_drowsing.name: scroll of drowsing
scroll_of_drowsing.lore: A midwife's soothing-cantrip. Every creature in sight drifts for six heartbeats.

scroll_of_sleep.name: scroll of sleep
scroll_of_sleep.lore: Penned by the dream-weavers of Morpheus in ink distilled from poppy essence. Every creature in sight is swept into deep slumber.

scroll_of_deep_slumber.name: scroll of deep slumber
scroll_of_deep_slumber.lore: The deep-slumber working, said to have been used to render whole armies unconscious in the wars of the ancient Levant.

scroll_of_quickness.name: scroll of quickness
scroll_of_quickness.lore: A courier's quickness-charm. Ten heartbeats of doubled pace.

scroll_of_haste.name: scroll of haste
scroll_of_haste.lore: Written in quicksilver ink -- or so the seller claimed -- by fleet-footed Hermes himself. Fifteen heartbeats of doubled pace.

scroll_of_alacrity.name: scroll of alacrity
scroll_of_alacrity.lore: The great alacrity-working. Thirty-eight heartbeats of the messenger-god's own pace.

scroll_of_blink.name: scroll of blink
scroll_of_blink.lore: An apprentice's short-teleport working. You dissolve here and reconstitute on some walkable tile the scroll picks.

scroll_of_teleportation.name: scroll of teleportation
scroll_of_teleportation.lore: The Alexandrian spatial working. Your body dissolves here and reconstitutes at a place you have already been.

scroll_of_recall.name: scroll of recall
scroll_of_recall.lore: The recall-rite of the deep-cave surveyors. Space folds -- you step directly onto the stairs down.

scroll_of_spark.name: scroll of spark
scroll_of_spark.lore: An artificer's apprentice-charm. One wand in your pack gains a single charge.

scroll_of_charging.name: scroll of charging
scroll_of_charging.lore: Inscribed by the artificers who first learned to trap raw magical force in crystalline matrices. Every wand you carry gains a charge.

scroll_of_recharge.name: scroll of recharge
scroll_of_recharge.lore: The full recharge working. Every wand in your pack crackles up to its maximum charges at once.

scroll_of_light.name: scroll of light
scroll_of_light.lore: A candle-lighter's cantrip on parchment. Soft light spreads outward, revealing half the floor.

scroll_of_illumination.name: scroll of illumination
scroll_of_illumination.lore: A greater illumination-rite. The whole floor lights up, and for ten heartbeats you see the position of every living thing.

scroll_of_revelation.name: scroll of revelation
scroll_of_revelation.lore: The revelation-working of the astronomer-priests. Full illumination, and sixty heartbeats of clairvoyance, and every creature on the floor lit like a star in your mind.

scroll_of_enchant_ring.name: scroll of enchant ring
scroll_of_enchant_ring.lore: Written by enchanter-jewelers of the elven courts. One accessory you wear gains an additional layer of power.

scroll_of_trinketry.name: scroll of trinketry
scroll_of_trinketry.lore: A master-jeweler's rite. Two accessories on your person are enchanted by two.

scroll_of_master_trinketry.name: scroll of master trinketry
scroll_of_master_trinketry.lore: The great trinketry-working. Every accessory you wear is elevated by three.

scroll_of_enchantment.name: scroll of enchantment
scroll_of_enchantment.lore: A universal enchantment-rite from the Alexandrian school. Three pieces of your equipped kit gain a rune.

scroll_of_greater_enchantment.name: scroll of greater enchantment
scroll_of_greater_enchantment.lore: The greater universal-enchantment. Five pieces of your equipped kit gain two runes each.

scroll_of_grand_enchantment.name: scroll of grand enchantment
scroll_of_grand_enchantment.lore: The grand universal-enchantment. Every piece of gear you wear gains three runes at once.

scroll_of_stone.name: scroll of stone
scroll_of_stone.lore: A stone-caller's rite. A hail of falling rock crashes down on every foe in sight, scaling with your wit.

scroll_of_earth.name: scroll of earth
scroll_of_earth.lore: Ancient druidic script that calls upon the weight of the earth itself. Boulders crash down upon every visible foe.

scroll_of_cataclysm.name: scroll of cataclysm
scroll_of_cataclysm.lore: The great cataclysm-working. The ceiling opens and a mountain's worth of stone crashes down on everything in sight.

scroll_of_smiting.name: scroll of smiting
scroll_of_smiting.lore: A minor annihilation-rite. Four of the weakest creatures in sight are unmade in a flash of white light.

scroll_of_annihilation.name: scroll of annihilation
scroll_of_annihilation.lore: A greater annihilation-rite. Half of every non-boss creature in sight is unmade at once.

scroll_of_extinction.name: scroll of extinction
scroll_of_extinction.lore: The most feared rite in the archivist's catalogue. Every non-boss creature in sight dissolves in a flash of obliterating white energy. Bosses and the mightiest of foes are unaffected.

scroll_of_purge.name: scroll of purge
scroll_of_purge.lore: A lesser purge-working. The most common kind of creature in sight is erased from this floor.

scroll_of_genocide.name: scroll of genocide
scroll_of_genocide.lore: A terrifying scroll of absolute power. Speaking the words erases the two most common kinds of creature in sight from this floor. Even reading it feels like a transgression.

scroll_of_exile.name: scroll of exile
scroll_of_exile.lore: The great exile-working. Every kind of non-boss creature in sight is erased from this floor at once.

scroll_of_slow_time.name: scroll of slow time
scroll_of_slow_time.lore: A chronomancer's minor time-slowing rite. Ten heartbeats of stillness.

scroll_of_time_stop.name: scroll of time stop
scroll_of_time_stop.lore: The theoretical framework for this scroll was laid by Zeno of Elea, who proved logically that motion is an illusion. Fifteen heartbeats of absolute stillness.

scroll_of_timeless.name: scroll of timeless
scroll_of_timeless.lore: The great time-stop working. Twenty-five heartbeats of absolute stillness -- the dungeon holds its breath.

scroll_of_power.name: scroll of power
scroll_of_power.lore: A minor power-rite. The three faculties in which you are weakest are each permanently elevated by one.

scroll_of_greater_power.name: scroll of greater power
scroll_of_greater_power.lore: The greater power-working. Five of your faculties are permanently elevated by one.

scroll_of_great_power.name: scroll of great power
scroll_of_great_power.lore: The capstone work of the philosopher Porphyry, who spent forty years distilling the essence of Aristotle's categories into a single transformative incantation. Every faculty within you is permanently elevated by one.

dead_sea_scroll.name: Dead Sea Scroll
dead_sea_scroll.unidentified_name: a brittle parchment sealed in a clay jar
dead_sea_scroll.lore: Sealed in a clay jar in a cave near the sea for two thousand years. What was written on it is not what makes it powerful -- that it survived at all is. Read it and the shape of the whole dungeon is preserved in your mind the same way -- the walls, the corridors, the stairs, if not the shadows that walk between them.

scroll_of_the_labyrinth.name: Scroll of the Labyrinth
scroll_of_the_labyrinth.lore: Sealed with the mark of the Cretan Labyrinth. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_gorgon.name: Scroll of the Gorgon
scroll_of_the_gorgon.lore: Sealed with a serpent's eye. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_hoard.name: Scroll of the Dragon Hoard
scroll_of_the_hoard.lore: Sealed with a golden dragon scale. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_ragnarok.name: Scroll of Ragnarok
scroll_of_ragnarok.lore: Sealed with the howl of the World-Wolf. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_abyss.name: Scroll of the Abyss
scroll_of_the_abyss.lore: Sealed with the mark of the Bottomless Pit. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_arachne.name: Scroll of Arachne
scroll_of_arachne.lore: Sealed with a strand of unbreakable silk. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_lamia.name: Scroll of Lamia
scroll_of_lamia.lore: Sealed with a serpent's tear. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_talos.name: Scroll of Talos
scroll_of_talos.lore: Sealed with molten bronze. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_echidna.name: Scroll of Echidna
scroll_of_echidna.lore: Sealed with the mark of the Mother of Monsters. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_erlking.name: Scroll of the Erlking
scroll_of_the_erlking.lore: Sealed with a frozen leaf that never wilts. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_camazotz.name: Scroll of Camazotz
scroll_of_camazotz.lore: Sealed with a bat's wing pressed in wax. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_cacus.name: Scroll of Cacus
scroll_of_cacus.lore: Sealed with a scorch mark that still smolders. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_sphinx.name: Scroll of the Sphinx
scroll_of_the_sphinx.lore: Sealed with a riddle that answers itself. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_rangda.name: Scroll of Rangda
scroll_of_rangda.lore: Sealed with a lock of white hair. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_lion.name: Scroll of the Nemean Lion
scroll_of_the_lion.lore: Sealed with an impenetrable golden hair. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_baba_yaga.name: Scroll of Baba Yaga
scroll_of_baba_yaga.lore: Sealed with iron teeth marks. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_jormungandr.name: Scroll of Jormungandr
scroll_of_jormungandr.lore: Sealed with a scale from the World Serpent. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_set.name: Scroll of Set
scroll_of_set.lore: Sealed with red sand from the desert of storms. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_green.name: Scroll of the Green Knight
scroll_of_the_green.lore: Sealed with a holly branch that bleeds sap. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_charybdis.name: Scroll of Charybdis
scroll_of_charybdis.lore: Sealed with salt water that never dries. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_ravana.name: Scroll of Ravana
scroll_of_ravana.lore: Sealed with the sigil of Lanka. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_wendigo.name: Scroll of the Wendigo
scroll_of_the_wendigo.lore: Sealed with frost that bites the fingers. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_hunt.name: Scroll of the Wild Hunt
scroll_of_the_hunt.lore: Sealed with a horn blast frozen in wax. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_anansi.name: Scroll of Anansi
scroll_of_anansi.lore: Sealed with a web that glints like gold. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_nidhoggr.name: Scroll of Nidhoggr
scroll_of_nidhoggr.lore: Sealed with bark from the World Tree. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code!

scroll_of_the_pasture.name: Scroll of the Pasture
scroll_of_the_pasture.lore: Sealed with a brand shaped like a cow bell. A reward scroll from Dad -- show him this code! Moo.
